summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting routine transactions under its ongoing share repurchase programme, originally announced on 6 May 2026, as part of a larger buyback of up to DKK 15 billion over 12 months starting 4 February 2026. The filing discloses daily repurchases of B shares through 26 June 2026, with accumulated buybacks of 22,009,179 shares at an average price of DKK 268.02 per share, totaling DKK 5.9 billion. This is an ordinary capital return activity, not a special situation or event-driven restructuring.
